what: Boeing 747 primitives bench — v2 measurement-fidelity re-baseline decomposition
note: Identical-plane (same plane_sha256) before/after proof that the ~68 cap was substantially a MEASUREMENT artifact on the gemma track, and a genuine geometry assessment on the stronger Opus track. Three harness fixes: (1) SSAA render (SwiftShader ignores antialias), (2) view_visibility mask (rubric v2), (3) projected per-view framing (camera spec v2). NOT numerically comparable to v1 results.

opus_track_identical_original_plane.note: Opus lands ~68 both under old harness (claimed 67.84 samples=3) and corrected harness (68.0 samples=3): the render fixes barely move the strong judge — it already saw through the aliasing/thumbnail. So on Opus the ~68 is a genuine geometry assessment, not a measurement cap. Only the mask nudged it (+~0.5).

geometry_candidate_more_prominent_hump.caveat: Both judges are noisy (gemma ~±1.5/view, Opus samples=1 ~±1/view); the hump edit mainly targets the 3/4-front views where the original scored hump=3/silhouette=5.
